title: Enable auto-apply for the Default segment

blocks.content: Start here if you are not using segmentation yet. The Default segment holds the series that aren't assigned to a named segment.

1. Open **Adaptive Metrics**.
1. On **Overview**, click **Enable auto-apply** next to the **Segment** dropdown. The **Enable auto-apply per segment** dialog opens.
1. Select **Default**. If only Default exists, the dialog recommends creating more segments and includes **Go to Segments**. You can still enable auto-apply for Default. You use the segment you already have.
1. Select an **Auto-apply mode**.
1. Click **Apply**.

| Mode | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Coverage-first** | Applies every recommendation, including ones expected to add series for new usage. Choose it when adapting to usage matters more than limiting estimated series growth. |
| **Cost-first** | Applies recommendations expected to reduce or keep the estimated series count, plus increases up to what those reductions free up. Choose it when limiting estimated series growth matters more than adapting to new usage. |

Both modes can skip some or all recommendations if the segment is at or near its limit on aggregation rules. An aggregation rule combines series into fewer series.

In **Cost-first**, a recommendation that would push the increase past what the reductions applied at the same time free up isn't applied automatically. It stays pending, and you can still apply it from the UI.
